arxiv-1805-01085.title: SHORT-MT: Optimal Solution of Linear Ordinary Differential Equations by Conjugate Gradient Method Thanks: Supported by NSFC 11471307 and CAS Research Program of Frontier Sciences (QYZDB-SSW-SYS026).
arxiv-1805-01085.creator: Wenqiang Yang, Wenyuan Wu, Robert M. Corless
arxiv-1805-01085.description: Abstract Solving initial value problems and boundary value problems of Linear Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) plays an important role in many applications. There are various numerical methods and solvers to obtain approximate solutions represented by points. However, few work about optimal solution to minimize the residual can be found in the literatures.

arxiv-2101-10599.title: A Survey and Analysis on Automated Glioma Brain Tumor Segmentation and Overall Patient Survival Prediction Journal: Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering Thanks: The article has been published in Springer Journal, “Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering”, which is accessible usi
arxiv-2101-10599.creator: Rupal R. Agravat, Mehul S. Raval
arxiv-2101-10599.description: Abstract Glioma is the deadliest brain tumor with high mortality. Treatment planning by human experts depends on the proper diagnosis of physical symptoms along with Magnetic Resonance (MR) image analysis. Highly variability of a brain tumor in terms of size, shape, location, and a high volume of MR images make the analysis time-consuming.

arxiv-2207-13177.title: Sliced Wasserstein Variational Inference
arxiv-2207-13177.creator: Mingxuan Yi, Song Liu
arxiv-2207-13177.description: Abstract Variational Inference approximates an unnormalized distribution via the minimization of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. Although this divergence is efficient for computation and has been widely used in applications, it suffers from some unreasonable properties. For example, it is not a proper metric, i.e., it is non-symmetric and does not preserve the triangle inequality.

arxiv-2307-11408.title: Direct and inverse modeling of soft robots by learning a condensed FEM model
arxiv-2307-11408.creator: Etienne Ménager, Tanguy Navez, Olivier Goury, Christian Duriez
arxiv-2307-11408.description: Abstract The Finite Element Method (FEM) is a powerful modeling tool for predicting the behavior of soft robots. However, its use for control can be difficult for non-specialists of numerical computation: it requires an optimization of the computation to make it real-time. In this paper, we propose a learning-based approach to obtain a compact but sufficiently rich mechanical representation.

arxiv-2309-07874.title: Ca 2 Lib : Simple and Accurate LiDAR-RGB Calibration using Small Common Markers
arxiv-2309-07874.creator: Emanuele Giacomini*, Leonardo Brizi*, Luca Di Giammarino, Omar Salem, Giorgio Grisetti
arxiv-2309-07874.description: Abstract In many fields of robotics, knowing the relative position and orientation between two sensors is a mandatory precondition to operate with multiple sensing modalities. In this context, the pair LiDAR-RGB cameras offer complementary features: LiDARs yield sparse high quality range measurements, while RGB cameras provide a dense color measurement of the environment.

arxiv-2403-00948.title: A genetic algorithm for the response of twisted nematic liquid crystals to an applied field
arxiv-2403-00948.creator: Alicia Sit, Francesco Di Colandrea, Alessio D’Errico, Ebrahim Karimi
arxiv-2403-00948.description: Abstract When an external field is applied across a liquid-crystal cell, the twist and tilt distributions cannot be calculated analytically and must be extracted numerically. In the standard approach, the Euler-Lagrange equations are derived from the minimization of the free energy of the system and then solved via finite-difference methods, often implemented in commercial software.

arxiv-2405-06126.title: Quantum Secure Anonymous Communication Networks Mohammad Saidur Rahman, Stephen DiAdamo are with the Cisco Quantum Lab in Los Angeles, USA and Munich, Germany. arxiv-2405-06126.creator: Stephen DiAdamo, Miralem Mehic, Charles Fleming
arxiv-2405-06126.description: Abstract Anonymous communication networks (ACNs) enable Internet browsing in a way that prevents the accessed content from being traced back to the user. This allows a high level of privacy, protecting individuals from being tracked by advertisers or governments, for example.

arxiv-2501-06259.title: Quantum Down Sampling Filter for Variational Auto-encoder
arxiv-2501-06259.creator: Farina Riaz, Fakhar Zaman, Hajime Suzuki, Sharif Abuadbba, David Nguyen
arxiv-2501-06259.description: Abstract Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are fundamental for generative modeling and image reconstruction, yet their performance often struggles to maintain high fidelity in reconstructions. This study introduces a hybrid model, quantum variational autoencoder (Q-VAE), which integrates quantum encoding within the encoder while utilizing fully connected layers to extract meaningful representations. The decoder uses transposed convolution layers for up-sampling.

arxiv-2509-13433.title: Global propagation of singularities for magnetic mechanical systems
arxiv-2509-13433.creator: Piermarco Cannarsa, Wei Cheng, Jiahui Hong and Wenxue Wei *
arxiv-2509-13433.description: Abstract . We prove that singularities propagate globally for viscosity solutions of Hamilton-Jacobi equations related to magnetic mechanical systems on closed Riemannian manifolds. Our main result shows that for any weak KAM solution u u , the singular set Sing ​ ( u ) \text{Sing}\,(u) remains invariant under the generalized gradient flow dynamics.

arxiv-2602-15233.title: Computing Perfect Bayesian Equilibria, with Application to Empirical Game-Theoretic Analysis Conference: Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026); May 25 – 29, 2026; Paphos, Cyprus 937 Thanks: ∗ Konicki worked on this paper while a PhD stude
arxiv-2602-15233.creator: Christine Konicki ∗, Mithun Chakraborty, Michael P. Wellman
arxiv-2602-15233.description: Abstract . Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium (PBE) is a refinement of the Nash equilibrium for imperfect-information extensive-form games (EFGs) that enforces consistency between the two components of a solution: agents’ strategy profile describing their decisions at information sets and the belief system quantifying their uncertainty over histories within an information set.

pmc-10719197.title: Surgical technique: posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) reconstruction using double posteromedial arthroscopic portals
pmc-10719197.creator: Gian Andrea Lucidi, Romain Seil, Piero Agostinone, Cécile Toanen, Alberto Grassi, Stefano Zaffagnini
pmc-10719197.description: The posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) reconstruction is a technically demanding surgical procedure that requires optimal identification of both the femoral and the tibial anatomical footprints. To aid the tibial tunnel placement and many authors recommend creating a posteromedial (PM) portal.

pmc-11476486.title: Cerebrospinal Fluid and Peripheral Blood Lymphomonocyte Single-Cell Transcriptomics in a Subject with Multiple Sclerosis Acutely Infected with HIV
pmc-11476486.creator: Carmela Pinnetti, Gabriella Rozera, Francesco Messina, Pietro Giorgio Spezia, Elisabetta Lazzari, Lavinia Fabeni, Giovanni Chillemi, Daniele Pietrucci, Shalom Haggiag, Ilaria Mastrorosa, Alessandra Vergori, Enrico Girardi, Andrea Antinori, Fabrizio Maggi, Isabella Abbate, Se-Kwon Kim
pmc-11476486.description: Signatures of neurodegeneration in clinical samples from a subject with multiple sclerosis (MS) acutely infected with HIV were investigated with single-cell transcriptomics using 10X Chromium technology. Sequencing was carried out on NovaSeq-TM, and the analysis was performed with Cell Ranger software (v 7.1.0) associated with a specifically established bioinformatic pipeline.

pmc-11513480.title: Anemarrhena asphodeloides Bunge polysaccharides alleviate lipoteichoic acid-induced lung inflammation and modulate gut microbiota in mice
pmc-11513480.creator: Yuqi Wen, Hidayat Ullah, Renzhen Ma, Nabeel Ahmad Farooqui, Jiaxin Li, Yamina Alioui, Juanjuan Qiu
pmc-11513480.description: Pneumonia remains a prevalent infection primary ailment characterized by severe lung inflammation, leading to respiratory distress and significant mortality rates, particularly affecting young children in less developed regions. This study explores the therapeutic potential of low and high-molecular weight polysaccharides derived from Anemarrhena asphodeloides in a murine model of lipoteichoic acid (LTA)-induced pneumonia, which represents bacterial-induced lung inflammation.

pmc-11584949.title: Digital technology and Chinese-style industrial modernization: Dynamic threshold effect based on R&D Human resources
pmc-11584949.creator: Yingying Ding, Xiaojing Song, Yue Zhu, Ruichao Xi, Ziyi Shi
pmc-11584949.description: Based on the construction of digital technology evaluation index system, this paper builds a dynamic threshold regression model to explore the complex impact of digital technology on Chinese-style industrial modernization under the threshold of R&D human resources, taking 30 provinces as research objects.

pmc-11607862.title: Preventive effects of melatonin and amifostine on irradiated rats with experimental periodontitis
pmc-11607862.creator: Nur Yorgancilar, Oguz Kose, Sema Yilmaz Rakici, Tolga Mercantepe, Kerimali Akyildiz, Levent Tumkaya, Adnan Yilmaz
pmc-11607862.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe aim of this study was to investigate the preventive effects of amifostine and melatonin oxidatively, biochemically and histomorphometrically in rats with radiotherapy-induced experimental periodontitis.Methods40 female Sprague-Dawley rats were divided into 5 groups: Control, experimental periodontitis (Ep), Ep + radiotherapy (Ep + Rt), Ep + Rt + amifostine (Ep + Rt + Ami), Ep + Rt + melatonin (Ep + Rt + Mel). The day after induction of periodontitis by ligature, a single dose of 5 Gy radiotherapy was administered.

pmc-12412919.title: Southern European Prospective Investigation Into Childhood Cancer and Nutrition (EPICkids): Study design and protocol
pmc-12412919.creator: Foteini Perganti, Inge Huybrechts, Adriana Cristina Balduzzi, Ronald Barr, Andrea Biondi, Aina Llenas Bladé, Evangelina Muñoz Bravo, Erika Damasco, Christina N. Katsagoni, Antonis Kattamis, Alvaro Lassaletta, Marta Llopis Lera, Anna Llort, Jessica Blanco Lopez, Antonio Perez Martinez, Maura Massimin
pmc-12412919.description: The survival rates for children with cancer have increased appreciably over the last few decades; however, childhood cancer survivors continue to suffer from long-lasting sequelae. Studies have demonstrated that the presence of malnutrition, over- and under-nutrition, at diagnosis or the duration of malnutrition during treatment is associated with increased toxicity, infection, and inferior survival.

pmc-12540911.title: Cortisol Concentration Is Reduced During the Workday but Is not Associated With Depressive Symptoms in Healthcare Workers During the COVID‐19 Outbreak
pmc-12540911.creator: Jeel Moya‐Salazar, Rosa Bermudo‐Rodríguez, Eliane A Goicochea‐Palomino, Belén Moya‐Salazar, Víctor Rojas‐Zumaran, Hans Contreras‐Pulache
pmc-12540911.description: Background and AimsThe concentration of cortisol varies during the day and is related to high‐stress situations that could lead to the development of mental disorders such as depression. We aimed to determine the level of cortisol and the presence of depression in health workers in the clinical pathology service of a specialized hospital during 2021.

pmc-12712644.title: ﻿Waterfalls as a reservoir for caddisfly larvae (Insecta, Trichoptera): exploring a poorly known habitat
pmc-12712644.creator: Darha Solano-Ulate, Monika Springer
pmc-12712644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ﻿AbstractWaterfalls have not been thoroughly studied as a habitat for freshwater macroinvertebrates, although they appear to be an exclusive environment for taxa with traits suited to these unique physical habitat conditions. To better understand the role of waterfalls as aquatic habitats in Costa Rica, macroinvertebrates were collected within the flow and spray zones of 38 waterfalls across the country, spanning an altitudinal range of 55 to 2,660 m above sea level, either by climbing up from the base or using rappel techniques

pmc-12747431.title: Identification of new triazoloquinoxaline amine derivatives with potent modulatory effects against Toll-like receptor 7 through pharmacophore-based virtual screening and molecular docking approaches
pmc-12747431.creator: Nasrin Saberi Harooni, Mohammad Reza Naimi-Jamal, Sajjad Gharaghani, Asal Katebi, Soheila Ajdary, Azar Tahghighi
pmc-12747431.description: Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) plays a key role in the signaling pathways involved in immunity by recognizing pathogen-associated molecular patterns. Due to its broad effectiveness in various diseases and the limited number of drugs on the market that act on this receptor, it remains an ideal target for pharmaceutical scientists.

pmc-12754776.title: G-quadruplex structures as modulators of alternative promoter usage
pmc-12754776.creator: Rongxin Zhang, Jean-Louis Mergny
pmc-12754776.description: The precise regulation of gene transcription relies on promoters, and the selection of specific promoters for a particular gene is a key determinant of transcript diversity. However, the regulatory mechanisms governing promoter selection are not fully understood. G-quadruplexes (G4s) are unique DNA noncanonical secondary structures that have emerged as important regulators of gene expression.

pmc-12800853.title: Durable Mid-Term Outcomes and High Rates of Meaningful Improvement After Hip Arthroscopy With Concomitant Periacetabular Osteotomy
pmc-12800853.creator: Ady H. Kahana-Rojkind, Elizabeth G. Walsh, Roger Quesada-Jimenez, Benjamin D. Kuhns, Justin M. LaReau, Benjamin G. Domb
pmc-12800853.description: PurposeTo evaluate 5-year outcomes following combined hip arthroscopy and periacetabular osteotomy (PAO) for the treatment of acetabular dysplasia and intra-articular pathology, with a focus on the rates of achieving clinically meaningful outcome thresholds.MethodsMinimum 5-year outcome data from a prospectively maintained database were queried to identify patients who underwent concomitant primary hip arthroscopy and PAO between October 2010 and July 2019.

pmc-12903312.title: Enhancing PARP inhibitor efficacy in ovarian cancer: targeting the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway
pmc-12903312.creator: Yixuan Wang, Qing Xia, Xinjia Wang, Yiwei Lu, Shizhuo Wang, Yisheng Jiao
pmc-12903312.description: Ovarian cancer remains one of the most lethal gynecologic malignancies, often marked by late-stage diagnosis and resistance to conventional therapies. Poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors have significantly advanced treatment, particularly in tumors with homologous recombination deficiencies, such as BRCA1/2 mutations.

pmc-13056006.title: “Eye-Conic” Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals the Layer-Specific Molecular Alterations in Corneas of Patients With Keratoconus
pmc-13056006.creator: Alicja Wysocka, Katarzyna Jaskiewicz-Rajewicz, Jakub Wozniak, Malgorzata Rydzanicz, Rafal Ploski, Monika Udziela, Jacek P. Szaflik, Marzena Gajecka
pmc-13056006.description: PurposeDue to the structural complexity of the human cornea as well as the characteristic histopathological changes occurring in keratoconus (KTCN) cornea, there is a need to identify the associated cellular and molecular layer-specific alterations in the process of KTCN cone formation.MethodsThe spatial transcriptomics (ST) approach was applied for KTCN and control corneas to investigate the layer-specific alterations.

pmc-13246500.title: Commentary: Nurses at the frontline of the Tuberculosis epidemic—strengthening care in patients across health settings
pmc-13246500.creator: Lwandile Tokwe
pmc-13246500.description: ugh the administration of immunisations such as the Bacille Calmette–Guérin (BCG) vaccine at birth (Okafor et al., 2026). Patients with active TB are seen regularly by nurses who provide care and support to improve treatment outcomes.

pmc-13449675.title: A rare case of native Thrombotic aortic valve thrombosis with acute coronary syndrome-like presentation
pmc-13449675.creator: Hamidreza Biranvand, Akbar Shafiee, Dorsa Ghorban Sarvi, Shervin Mossavarali, Mohammad Sahebjam, Mehdi Dehghani Firoozabadi
pmc-13449675.description: BackgroundThrombosis of the native aortic valve is a rare, potentially embolic condition that has been increasingly identified with modern imaging and can present variably from myocardial infarction to stroke, limb ischemia, or be clinically silent. We present an idiopathic native aortic valve thrombus manifesting as suspected acute coronary syndrome.

pmc-13478701.title: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis in Adults: A Canadian Multicenter Case Series
pmc-13478701.creator: Stephanie Quon, Yaswanta Gummadi, Ibrahim Elsharawi, Jessica Dobson, Mariam Goubran, Ryan J Stubbins, Eli L Diamond, Luke Y C Chen
pmc-13478701.description: Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH) is a rare clonal myeloid neoplasm. Canadian data on clinical characteristics, molecular profile, and treatment outcomes is limited. This study aims to report the initial experience of a Canadian rare diseases program, reflecting “real‐world” diagnostic pathways, referral patterns, and treatment heterogeneity across multiple provinces.

pmc-13570526.title: Effectiveness of mobile application versus intranet-based posting for pressure ulcer education in nurses: a randomised controlled trial
pmc-13570526.creator: Suryang Seo, Eunji Lee, Jaeyeon Kang, Minho Jung, Moonsook Kim, Haeyoung Lee
pmc-13570526.description: BackgroundPressure ulcers are major patient safety concerns, and bedside nurses’ competencies are central to prevention. Given nurses’ workload in clinical settings, digital education delivery through mobile apps or intranet may be effective. However, direct comparisons between these modalities remain limited.
